title: A goal research story whose rows land in kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv is landed with land, not done, since that file is code lane
goal: The kb-sprint skill's plan step 1 and the research story's goal text (the string bl_items.py writes) say that a goal research story finished with tested rows in the _self eval file lookup_eval.csv (a code-lane path, _tools/kblane.py) lands through backlog.py land --wait-merge, not done --commit, so no orchestrator meets the refusal 'code commit(s) ... are not on origin/main' (SP-rvslem3h: done of ST-ls2ge3bz refused once for this).

run: import glob,json,subprocess,sys,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True);subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'new','sprint','--title','T','--goal','G'],capture_output=True);g=[x['goal'] for x in (json.load(open(f,encoding='utf-8')) for f in glob.glob(d+'/**/*.json',recursive=True)) if x.get('goal_research')];s=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split('## start SP')[0].split('## plan')[1];ok=bool(g) and 'lookup_eval.csv' in g[0] and 'backlog.py land' in g[0] and 'lookup_eval.csv' in s;print('research goal text and plan step name land for lookup_eval rows:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
